metadata.title: Bounds for the original mean row weight of admissible interpolation data
metadata.statement:
Let $\nu$ be real and let $d$ be fixed admissible data from the original determinant construction. At every positive real height $H$, its normalized mean row weight $b_d(H)$ satisfies

$$0\le b_d(H)\le\theta_d.$$

Here $\theta_d$ is the theta parameter of the fixed base data, and $b_d(H)$ is the weighted row sum divided by the row count times $H$. This controls the mean used in the conditional determinant contradiction.
metadata.explanation: Every row has nonnegative logarithmic cost, and the defining strict weighted simplex bounds its cost by the height times theta. Sum the row bounds and divide by the positive row count and height.
